measurement_notes.boron: Effective full-power days, boron ppm, source MWD column. Not calendar days.

measurement_notes.hzp: Cycle 1 bank worths are measured along an insertion sequence; cycle 2 reports individual banks. No uncertainty provided in these tables.
measurement_notes.power: Calendar days since beginning of cycle; percent rated power. Source sample spacing retained. The separate 101 cooling-days annotation between cycles is not a power observation.
